data.$comment: Dữ liệu quan hệ phẳng — đúng 1 defect case (Q3 - Internal Defect). Mỗi mảng là một sheet; join bằng notification_id.

notifications.symptom_short_text: Cracks at retainer flange radius after forming

causes_ishikawa.description: EMP-8140, Shift A - press setup verified against the setup sheet
EQ-PRESS09-001 tonnage and shut height logged within tolerance
DOC-10450 Rev A - forming sequence and radii unchanged since qualification
Coil lot COIL-6612 delivered as DC04 but hardness 214 HV and elongation 11% match DC01 full-hard; supplier shipped the wrong grade against the same part number
Hardness tester GA-0620, last cal 2026-06-09, R&R 3.9%

actions.action_text: Quarantine all SR8 from COIL-6612 and hardness-test every remaining coil in the store
Return coil lot COIL-6612 to the supplier and raise a supplier corrective action request
Add hardness and elongation checks to the incoming inspection plan for all formed-steel part numbers

lessons_learned.what_worked: Coil-level traceability tied all 1,240 cracked parts to a single delivery within a day
lessons_learned.what_didnt: Incoming inspection could not distinguish two grades that look identical and share a part number

is_is_not.is_where_when_it_happens: SR8 retainers formed from coil lot COIL-6612
is_is_not.is_not_where_when_it_doesnt: SR8 from coil lots COIL-6588 and COIL-6640 - same press, same die, same operators
is_is_not.notes: Defect tracks the coil lot exclusively

five_why_chain.question: Why do the retainers crack at the flange radius?
five_why_chain.answer: Elongation measured 11% against a 22% minimum, so the material cannot survive the forming strain

five_why_chain.question: Why is elongation half of specification?
five_why_chain.answer: Coil lot COIL-6612 has hardness 214 HV against a 160 HV maximum, consistent with a full-hard grade rather than the specified DC04

five_why_chain.question: Why did a wrong-grade coil enter production? (root cause)
five_why_chain.answer: Incoming inspection for this part number checks dimensions and surface only; there is no mechanical property check to catch a grade substitution

constraints.rule: Mỗi entity: tổ hợp primary_key phải duy nhất.
Mọi giá trị FK phải tồn tại trong entity đích (trừ FK ra BP_DIRECTORY — master data ngoài dataset).
Mỗi notification_id phải có đúng 6 dòng causes_ishikawa, một dòng cho mỗi category trong enum ishikawa_category.
Category có is_root_cause = 'Y' phải khớp với bước '(root cause)' trong five_why_chain.
2 <= số dòng five_why_chain per case <= 5; step_no liên tục bắt đầu từ 1.
notifications.team_size = số dòng team_assignments của case đó (khi team_size là số).
Mỗi case có đúng 1 dòng partner_role = '8D Team Leader'.
customer_facing_summary / internal_facing_summary và dữ liệu thật ở customer_reference chỉ có giá trị khi origin = 'Q1 - Customer Complaint'.
action_type ánh xạ D3/D5/D7; case đã đóng phải có đủ Containment + Corrective + Preventive.
completion_date chỉ non-null khi status thuộc {'Completed', 'Closed'}.
spc_process_data tổng hợp theo Material+Characteristic(+Vendor), không join trực tiếp theo notification_id.
